entities.name: Amonkhet
entities.description: An Ancient Egypt-inspired plane overtaken by Nicol Bolas, where the dead rise as undead under the Curse of Wandering.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The elder dragon planeswalker who corrupted Amonkhet, killed its people, and built the trials to raise an army of Eternals.

entities.name: Naktamun
entities.description: The central city-state of Amonkhet, destroyed in the Hour of Devastation and later rebuilt.

entities.name: Hekma
entities.description: The protective barrier of Naktamun, destroyed by the Phyrexians and recreated.

entities.name: Broken Lands
entities.description: The desert and ruins surrounding Naktamun, roamed by the undead.

entities.name: Curse of Wandering
entities.description: The phenomenon in which everything that dies on Amonkhet rises as undead until only bones remain.

entities.name: Second Sun
entities.description: The smaller of the twin suns, which approached Bolas's Horn Monument as a harbinger of his return.

entities.name: Five gods
entities.description: The gods of Amonkhet, originally eight, who were sealed or brainwashed to steward the plane for Bolas.

entities.name: Hazoret
entities.description: The jackal god of zeal, the only surviving original god, who protected the survivors and fought the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Oketra
entities.description: The cat god of solidarity, deceased.

entities.name: Kefnet
entities.description: The ibis god of knowledge, deceased.

entities.name: Bontu
entities.description: The crocodile god of ambition who betrayed her siblings, deceased.

entities.name: Rhonas
entities.description: The cobra god of strength, deceased.

entities.name: Scarab God
entities.description: A surviving insect god who fought the Phyrexians at Naktamun.

entities.name: Locust God
entities.description: A surviving insect god who fought the Phyrexians at Naktamun.

entities.name: Sab-Sunen
entities.description: The new frog-headed goddess of the Luxa.

entities.name: Ketramose
entities.description: The new lion-headed god of breaking dawn, born from the Luxa's reeds.

entities.name: Eternals
entities.description: Zombie warriors preserved in lazotep who retain their skills and have unthinking loyalty to Bolas.

entities.name: Viziers
entities.description: Chosen servants of the gods who led rituals and oversaw the trials.

entities.name: Anointed
entities.description: The fallen embalmed and awakened to perform service in Naktamun.

entities.name: Trials of the Five Gods
entities.description: The five tests of Solidarity, Knowledge, Strength, Ambition and Zeal that initiates faced.

entities.name: Hour of Revelation
entities.description: The moment the God-Pharaoh was revealed as a malevolent dragon.

entities.name: Hour of Devastation
entities.description: Bolas's return, which destroyed Naktamun and killed most of the gods.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: The battle in which Bolas sent Tezzeret to Amonkhet to activate the Planar Bridge.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: A planeswalker sent by Bolas to Amonkhet to activate the Planar Bridge.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A golem planeswalker who helped defeat Tezzeret.

entities.name: Samut
entities.description: An Amonkheti who helped defeat Tezzeret and returned to defend the plane against Phyrexia.

entities.name: Ob Nixilis
entities.description: A planeswalker who helped defeat Tezzeret.

entities.name: Dack Fayden
entities.description: A planeswalker who helped defeat Tezzeret.

entities.name: Djeru
entities.description: Hazoret's loyal lieutenant who led elite fighters against the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Vorinclex
entities.description: A Phyrexian whose Copper Host was the main invasion force on Amonkhet.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The invaders who terraformed the desert and destroyed the Hekma.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The Phyrexian invasion in which Amonkhet was a target.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A planeswalker who examined Naktamun's leylines and contacted the Worldsoul.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A planeswalker who believed Bolas created Amonkhet.

entities.name: Temmet
entities.description: A vizier whose body was revived by Ketramose.

entities.name: Champions of Amonkhet
entities.description: Amonkhet's team in the second Ghirapur Grand Prix, led by Champion Zahur and Basri Ket.

entities.name: Chitin Court
entities.description: The insect gods' court that Hazoret's cadres stalk in the Broken Lands.

events.summary: Bolas corrupts a pre-existing plane, kills every being old enough to walk, overtakes the gods, seals three away and brainwashes five to steward the plane.
events.quote: He sealed three of the gods away, outside the Hekma and left behind five gods to steward the plane until his fateful return.

events.summary: Bolas engineers a world where inhabitants reach physical perfection before killing each other in the Trials, to create an army of Eternals.
events.quote: Bolas's goal was the creation of an army of Zombie warriors known as Eternals

events.summary: The Hour of Revelation reveals the God-Pharaoh as a malevolent dragon and the survivors flee into the desert.
events.quote: the survivors fled into the desert, leaving the destroyed city behind to forge a new destiny

events.summary: Bolas's return in the Hour of Devastation kills most of the gods, leaving Hazoret, the Scarab God and the Locust God.
events.quote: After Bolas's return to the plane during the Hour of Devastation , the majority of the gods were killed.

events.summary: Bolas sends Tezzeret to activate the Planar Bridge; Karn, Samut, Ob Nixilis and Dack Fayden defeat him, and Hazoret gives them her spear.
events.quote: Hazoret gave them her spear, reassuring Samut about the condition of Amonkhet's population

events.summary: Hazoret and the mortals bring the last two corrupted gods away from Naktamun, repopulate the city and create a new Hekma.
events.quote: They repopulated the city and created a new Hekma .

events.summary: Vorinclex's Copper Host invades, terraforming the desert and trying to convert the dead; survivors go into hiding then strike back.
events.quote: Vorinclex's Copper Host was the main invasion force on Amonkhet.

events.summary: The Scarab and Locust Gods distract the Phyrexians while Hazoret ignites their glistening oil and Djeru's crop dismembers them.
events.quote: Hazoret used her flaming spear to ignite the glistening oil within the Phyrexians' veins.

events.summary: The Phyrexians destroy the Hekma but the Amonkheti defense, bolstered by the ancient dead, succeeds.
events.quote: Although the Phyrexians were able to destroy the Hekma, the Amonkheti defense was successful.

events.summary: The insect gods retreat to the Broken Lands, and Hazoret helps rebuild Naktamun as the Luxa floods away the invaders' remains.
events.quote: the inscrutable insect gods retreated to the Broken Lands

events.summary: The living and loyal undead ally at the Tombs Before Time, beginning reconciliation after the invasion.
events.quote: The living agreed, marking an alliance at the Tombs Before Time

events.summary: Sab-Sunen appears and Ketramose is born from the Luxa's reeds as new gods of Amonkhet.
events.quote: the lion -headed god Ketramose was born from the reeds that grew at the banks of the Luxa

relations.note: The gods were brainwashed to believe they were his stewards.
relations.quote: were brainwashed to believe they were created by the God-Pharaoh to act as his stewards
with Djeru as her loyal lieutenant

relations.note: Karn, Samut, Ob Nixilis and Dack Fayden defeated him.
relations.quote: After his defeat at the hands of Karn , Samut , Ob Nixilis , and Dack Fayden

relations.note: Bolas sent him to activate the Planar Bridge.
relations.quote: Nicol Bolas sent Tezzeret to Amonkhet to activate the Planar Bridge

relations.note: She reassured Samut and aided the survivors.
relations.quote: Together, the goddess and the mortals brought the last two corrupted gods away from Naktamun .

relations.note: New gods who arose after the Phyrexians' repulsion.
relations.quote: After the repulsion of the Phyrexians, two new gods appeared.
